summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The Corgi TSLA 2x Daily ETF (TESC) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in consumer discretionary equity. The fund provides 2x leveraged exposure, less fees and expenses, to the daily price movement for shares of Tesla, Inc.  (NASDAQ: TSLA) through derivatives such as swaps. TESC was launched on Jun 26, 2026 and is issued by Corgi.
